svg.title: The way of an issue
svg.desc: You open an issue. The issue assistant labels it from its form and gives a first analysis, written by an AI that only reads. When it needs more information, the issue lifecycle reminds you after 15 days and closes the issue after 30 days without an answer, and your answer goes back to the assistant; a possible duplicate closes after 3 days unless someone objects. Otherwise a pull request fixes the issue; when it merges, the issue gets the label fixed-in-next-release, and the release that ships the fix closes it with a link to the release, in the milestone of the release. You are orange, the bots blue, and the closed issue green.
